research_change.notes: The documented MCP Server changed from the authenticated API endpoint https://api.x.com/mcp to the public documentation endpoint https://docs.x.com/mcp. Authentication changed from an app-only Bearer Token to open access, removing developer-account, app, API-credit, credential, and header setup. The provider anchor changed to confirm-public-docs-server, and Speakeasy setup changed from a conditional catalog/custom path to catalog-only. Both setup files require re-drafting and prior reviews are invalidated.
